name: number-input
title: Number Input
description: A number input with increment/decrement steppers, min/max/step constraints, and a scrub area.

props.name: allowMouseWheel
props.description: Whether to allow mouse wheel to change the value

props.name: allowOverflow
props.description: Whether to allow the value overflow the min/max range

props.name: clampValueOnBlur
props.description: Whether to clamp the value when the input loses focus (blur)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the input.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the number input is disabled.

props.name: focusInputOnChange
props.description: Whether to focus input when the value changes

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the input element.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: The options to pass to the `Intl.NumberFormat` constructor

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the number input. Useful for composition.

props.name: inputMode
props.description:
Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user. It also determines
the type of keyboard shown to the user on mobile devices

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the number input value is invalid.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Shift` key is held.

props.name: locale
props.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the number input

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the number input

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the number input. Useful for form submission.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The pattern used to check the <input> element's value against

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the number input is readonly

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the number input is required

props.name: smallStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Alt` key is held.

props.name: spinOnPress
props.description: Whether to spin the value when the increment/decrement button is pressed

props.name: step
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the input

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Function invoked when the number input is focused

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function invoked when the value changes

events.name: onValueCommit
events.description: Function invoked when the value is committed (when the input is blurred or the Enter key is pressed)

events.name: onValueInvalid
events.description: Function invoked when the value overflows or underflows the min/max range

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: An uncontrolled number input with `defaultValue` as its initial value.

examples.title: Min / max / step
examples.source:
import NumberInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/number-input/number-input.marko";

<NumberInput defaultValue="10" min=0 max=100 step=5 aria-label="Quantity"/>
examples.description: Constrain the range with `min` and `max`, and set the increment amount with `step`.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import NumberInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/number-input/number-input.marko";

<NumberInput defaultValue="0" disabled aria-label="Quantity"/>
examples.description: A disabled number input ignores pointer and keyboard input, including the steppers and scrub area.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import NumberInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/number-input/number-input.marko";
{ value = next; } min=0 max=999 /> value: ${value}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.
